featured_reviews.review_text:
Today, I visited Scoop Town ice cream parlour and stumbled upon a delightful Ice Cream parlour. Here, I discovered a plethora of fresh and wide variety of ice cream options and an array of unique desserts to explore. I decided to try their Black Currant and Special Mawa ice cream, which was an absolute delight. The both flavors was outstanding, and it tasted incredibly good.
Next, I ventured into something new and ordered their Chocolates Flavour Ice Cream with Cone. It was my first time trying this, and it was amazing. The portion was quite generous, making it perfect for sharing with 2 people and it was good, it was quite rich and heavy.
One of the highlights of this place is its beautiful location near the amazing garden with simple and incredible ambience, making it an ideal spot for everyone. Moreover, the store is impeccably clean, and they prioritize hygiene and there's friendly staff. If you ever find yourself near sion pratiksha nagar, I highly recommend you to visit this amazing place.

featured_reviews.name: Janhavi Raut
featured_reviews.review_text:
Visited Naturals Ice Cream, which is situated just beside our office, so it’s usually a go-to place for many of my colleagues after lunch.

I’m honestly not a big ice cream person, but I still end up going there often with my friends because they really enjoy it.

Among the flavors I’ve tried, I really liked the Tender Coconut ice cream. The little crunch of coconut malai in it makes it taste really nice and refreshing.

I also liked the Guava flavor, especially because of that pinch of masala, which gives it a unique taste.

Other than these two, for me, the rest of the flavors were just okay-okay, but if you enjoy ice cream, it’s definitely a nice place to visit and spend time with friends.

featured_reviews.name: Merlin Say’s
featured_reviews.review_text: This ice cream parlour is good… much like all other outlets. They have a lot of people coming in on a daily basis as they keep all variants and usually a fresh batch. Their malai ice cream with Mango slices was better than the Natural’s outlet in Powai.

featured_reviews.name: Sumit Pawar
featured_reviews.review_text: I went here with my friends. This place has good seating space. You will find more regular flavours here. The day when we visited they had limited choices. Overall it’s good space for the ice cream and to cheat chat with your friends.

featured_reviews.name: Adrian Rodrigues
featured_reviews.review_text:
Naturals is the best place to come and have authentic fruit based Ice Cream.
Their seasonal flavours are something you should not miss.
They also have other options like shakes and desserts.
It's a big parlour with ample space to sit and eat your icecream.
Parking is not available here unless you have a bike then you may find parking on the street.

The staff is understanding and patient with all your ice cream requirements.

The best part is that they do home delivery for nearby locations.

PS: If you are planning a visit here I personally request you to not park in front of the outlet as it creates a lot of commotion and difficulties for customers as well as local vehicles.

She is simply the best! Very kind and extremely accommodating. She accepted my last-minute order for muffins that I needed to distribute at my daughter’s school and still delivered everything on time, even though I reached out to her at the very last moment.
I had also ordered a fruit cake for my daughter’s birthday, and I must say—it was one of the best cakes we’ve had. Super moist, soft, not overly sweet, and the flavors were perfectly balanced.
If you’re looking for fresh cakes made with love, patience, and great technique—without artificial flavors or excessive sweetness—I would highly recommend her. Truly a delight to order from! 💛🎂

featured_reviews.name: Disha Chokhani
featured_reviews.review_text:
Hi. I’ve tried her stuffs at an exhibition once. There we and the kids too loved her desserts, pasties, donuts, bum cheese garlic bread and all. Thereafter, I thought of ordering the cake for my daughter’s birthday. We being Jain  prefer vegetarian kitchen. She made brownie cake and takeaway small boxes for her school which was amazing. Also ordered the barbie cake which was sooo yumm tasty and beautifully done.

The best part is she did it all in a day’s time and also did consider my opinion and executed it so well. Really happy with her services and very satisfied. You all must try. Tasty budget friendly and amazing cakes, brownies, desserts and more.

featured_reviews.name: Apurva Thampi
featured_reviews.review_text: I ordered 2 cakes for my daughter’s birthday a caramel and praline one and a chocolate one. Both the cakes were fingerlicking-ly good! Both the cakes tasted as good as they looked. The communication was very easy and Varshita willingly incorporated every design detail we wanted in the cake! Will definitely order again from Varshita for the next birthday too!

featured_reviews.review_text:

Spinach corn tart, Cheese balls, Chocolate and flower arrangements
Must like to add that the food was just fantastic and the hamper was perfectly decorated

Highly recommended.

featured_reviews.name: Janhavi Raut
featured_reviews.review_text:
Visited Faredoon at Marol Metro Station.

Talking about the taste, we tried their Paneer Bhurji Bun, and it was really great. The butter layer inside made it extra flavorful and rich. Then we had the Chicken Bhuna Bun, which was nicely stuffed but tasted okayish compared to the paneer one.

They also have a good variety of desserts, and the ones we tried were pretty good. Along with that, there’s a wide range of buns and rolls available in both veg and chicken options.

It’s newly opened and perfect for a quick bite near the metro. Overall, a nice place to try if you’re around Marol.

featured_reviews.name: Amit Shinde
featured_reviews.review_text: Located right at Marol Metro Station, Faredoon's is a top-tier Parsi "grab and go" spot that perfectly balances authentic flavor with a pocket-friendly price tag. It’s a heaven for carb-lovers, offering a wide array of fresh, tasty bread-based items and surprisingly rich traditional desserts like Lagan Nu Custard. Whether you’re rushing for a train or just need a quick, high-quality snack, this QSR delivers a punch of Parsi soul that's both convenient and consistently delicious.
